feedback: The candidate omits declared DIRECT_STATIC obligations in the COMPLETE dependency contract and normalized requirement. Add the framing owner/path model and constraints for framingIceStrengtheningAboveUpperIceWaterline and framingIceStrengtheningBelowLowerIceWaterline, including the IA Super versus IA/IB/IC table-selected thresholds by hullRegion and the required units, plus the conditional upperBowIceBeltRequired-to-reachesUpperBowIceBeltTop requirement. Preserve the termination-case rule, its adjacent-boundary alternatives, and the <=250 mm inclusive comparison.

Repair the termination-case constraints and preserve the prior table obligations. Add a datatype-constrained shape for iceStrengtheningTerminationAtAdjacentBoundaryPermitted (xsd:boolean) on each framingIceStrengtheningTerminationCase; the current SPARQL-only use permits malformed values, especially when the extension exceeds 250 mm. Keep the <=250 mm inclusive condition requiring that property to be true, while avoiding an unconditional presence requirement when the condition is not applicable. Also do not require reachesTankTopOrBelowFloorTop on every frame: it is only relevant to the bow branch of the Table 4-6 lower-extent rule; retain the conditional failure for an applicable bow case when the required true evidence is absent. Preserve the IA Super versus IA/IB/IC thresholds, hull-region selection, units, upper-bow conditional, termination-boundary alternatives, and correct owner/path structure.

current_feedback: The upperBowIceBeltRequired conditional is not enforced: the nested sh:property is evaluated against the boolean value true, not against the frame node, so upperBowIceBeltRequired=true can pass without reachesUpperBowIceBeltTop=true. Replace this ineffective nested constraint with a frame-level SHACL SPARQL constraint (or equivalent same-node constraint) that fails when upperBowIceBeltRequired is true and reachesUpperBowIceBeltTop is not true, while preserving the existing boolean datatype and conditional applicability.
